gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/event_indicators, but the vendor's session may not call GET /v1/trade/:id/event_indicators (trade#event_indicators is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the invited QA vendor, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is at least 1; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is at least 1; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
